question: Seven people, J, K, L, M, N, O and P, live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1 , the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor which is numbered 7. J lives on an odd numbered floor but not on floor number 5. Three people live between K and L, and L lives on the lowermost floor. O lives exactly between K and N. N lives on the topmost floor. P lives immediately above J. Who lives on the second floor?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people, J, K, L, M, N, O and P, live on different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1 , the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor which is numbered 7. 

1) N lives on the topmost floor.

2) J lives on an odd numbered floor but not on floor number 5.

3) Three people live between K and L, and L lives on the lowermost floor.

5) P lives immediately above J.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
